title: Exploiting System Management Mode with a very long interrupt
summary: A security research project demonstrating exploitation techniques for System Management Mode (SMM) vulnerabilities by crafting very long interrupt handlers. SMM operates at ring -2, the highest privilege level on x86 processors, making this research critical for firmware-level security analysis.
problem_solved: Exploits architectural weaknesses in SMM implementation that can lead to privilege escalation and persistent firmware-level compromise.
why_valuable: SMM vulnerabilities provide attackers with near-undetectable, highly privileged access below the operating system and hypervisor, making this research essential for defensive security teams and firmware developers.
